name: Demon
overview: Scripture reveals that demons, also called devils, are real spiritual beings opposed to God, to whom some have sacrificed (Deuteronomy 32:17; Psalms 106:37). They possess individuals, causing afflictions such as blindness and muteness, but Christ demonstrates His authority by casting them out and healing those afflicted (Matthew 12:22). Believers are reminded that the true struggle is spiritual, against these powerful dark forces, not against flesh and blood (Ephesians 6:12), and even demons acknowledge the one true God with fear (James 2:19).
